column7: 2026-11-06: Finance has not yet signed off the billing page wording, so no code changes yet to bytes.format (index.js). User said leave the code alone until then. Planned fix: truncate instead of toFixed rounding; this also removes the 1024KB rollover since values never round up to 1024.

2026-11-06: capacity-alerts: ops want bytes.format to round UP to the shown precision (never show less than real usage): 1048575 -> 1MB, 1025 -> 1.01KB, 2047 -> 2KB. This is the opposite of billing's truncate rule, which applies only to billing-ui. No code changes until ops finish reviewing alert thresholds. My recommendation (not yet agreed): opt-in rounding option rather than changing the default, and promote the unit after rounding.

2026-11-06: bytes.format truncates (toward zero) instead of toFixed rounding, per finance's never-show-more-than-used rule; finance sign-off given, fix done in index.js with tests in test/byte-format.js. Existing rounding tests (1.5KB@0dp, 1.05KB@1dp) were updated to truncation.
